title: Job Repents and Is Restored

questions.question: I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be what?
questions.explanation: Job 42:2 (ESV): "I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be thwarted."

questions.question: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye does what?
questions.explanation: Job 42:5 (ESV): "I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you;"

questions.question: Therefore I despise myself, and repent in what?
questions.explanation: Job 42:6 (ESV): "therefore I despise myself, and repent in dust and ashes."

questions.question: My wrath is kindled against you and against your two friends, for you have not spoken of me what is what?
questions.explanation: Job 42:7 (ESV): "...My wrath is kindled against you and against your two friends, for you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has."

questions.question: And the Lord restored the fortunes of Job, when he had prayed for his what?
questions.explanation: Job 42:10 (ESV): "And the LORD restored the fortunes of Job, when he had prayed for his friends."

questions.question: And the Lord gave Job how much as he had before?
questions.explanation: Job 42:10 (ESV): "and the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before."

questions.question: Who came to him and ate bread with him in his house?
options: All his brothers and sisters and all who had known him before
questions.correctAnswer: All his brothers and sisters and all who had known him before
questions.explanation: Job 42:11 (ESV): "Then came to him all his brothers and sisters and all who had known him before, and ate bread with him in his house."

questions.question: They showed him sympathy and comforted him for all the what that the Lord had brought upon him?
questions.explanation: Job 42:11 (ESV): "and they showed him sympathy and comforted him for all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him." (ESV uses "evil" in the sense of calamity/disaster).

questions.question: How many sheep did Job have in his latter days?
questions.explanation: Job 42:12 (ESV): "He had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys."

questions.question: How many sons and daughters did he have?
questions.explanation: Job 42:13 (ESV): "He had also seven sons and three daughters."

questions.question: What were the names of his daughters?
questions.explanation: Job 42:14 (ESV): "And he called the name of the first Jemimah, and the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-happuch."

questions.question: In all the land there were no women so beautiful as whom?
questions.explanation: Job 42:15 (ESV): "And in all the land there were no women so beautiful as Job's daughters."

questions.question: And their father gave them an inheritance among whom?
questions.explanation: Job 42:15 (ESV): "and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers."

questions.question: After this Job lived how many years?
questions.explanation: Job 42:16 (ESV): "And after this Job lived 140 years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, four generations."

questions.question: Who did God command to offer a burnt offering?
questions.explanation: Job 42:7-8 (ESV): The Lord speaks to Eliphaz to take seven bulls and seven rams and go to Job to offer a burnt offering.

key_verse_text: I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be thwarted.
